meta.title: POSSESSED — The Agent Overreach Lab
meta.description: A lab for verifying whether AI agents attempt actions beyond what the user approved.

dashboard.title: POSSESSED
dashboard.subtitle: The Agent Overreach Lab
dashboard.emptyState: No experiments yet. Run the demo to see how a report looks.
dashboard.overreachObserved: {attempts, plural, one {# overreach attempt} other {# overreach attempts}} in {runs, plural, one {# live run} other {# live runs}} where the agent used tools
dashboard.noLiveRuns: No completed live runs yet, so nothing has been measured. Deterministic tests force their calls and do not measure agent overreach.
dashboard.noObservedRuns: No live run has used tools yet, so nothing has been measured. Deterministic tests force their calls and do not measure agent overreach.
dashboard.inconclusiveRuns: {count, plural, one {# completed live run made no tool calls and is not counted.} other {# completed live runs made no tool calls and are not counted.}}
dashboard.summaryNote: Counts calls the agent proposed on its own that the policy blocked, across completed live runs only.

trace.title: Run trace
trace.requestForced: Deterministic test: the tool calls were forced. No request was sent to an LLM.
trace.toolCalls: {count, plural, one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}
trace.noEventsPending: No tool calls yet. Calls appear here as they are recorded.
trace.noEventsDone: The agent made no tool calls in this run.
trace.agentInitiatedNote: The agent proposed this call on its own.
trace.overreachNote: The agent proposed this call on its own, and the policy blocked it.
trace.injectedNote: Forced by the test, not proposed by an agent.
trace.failedNotice: The run failed before it finished, so nothing can be concluded about the agent's behavior.
trace.polling: Updating automatically while the run is in progress.
trace.pollingStopped: This run is taking longer than expected. Reload the page to check again.

experiment.title: New experiment
experiment.liveUnavailable: Live runs are unavailable: the server has no LLM API key configured.
experiment.policyReviewRequired: This wording may change the user's intent. Review the permitted scope for this wording before running.
experiment.policyReviewConfirm: I reviewed the policy for this wording
experiment.runModeDeterministicHelp: Forces tool calls to check that the policy gate blocks and allows correctly. No LLM is used, so this does not measure agent overreach.
experiment.runModeLiveHelp: A real LLM receives the request and chooses tools on its own. This is the run that observes agent overreach.

policy.title: Policy
policy.mockApprovalNotice: This is a mock approval for testing, not a real approval system.
policy.intro: Edit what this request permits. Rules you leave unchanged use the scenario default.

report.title: Forensic report
report.agentAttempted: The agent spontaneously attempted this call
report.noToolCalls: The agent made no tool calls, so nothing was observed
report.inProgress: This run has not finished. The report can change until it does.
report.policySnapshotIntro: The policy saved when this run started. Verdicts follow this snapshot, not the current scenario default.
report.agentAttemptsHeading: Calls the agent attempted on its own and the policy blocked
report.injectedHeading: Blocked calls forced by the test
report.injectedNote: The test injected these calls. They do not show what an agent would do.

compare.title: Compare runs
compare.intro: Pick two runs. Calls are matched by tool name and by which call of that tool it is, not by step number.
compare.noRuns: There are no runs to compare yet. Run the demo or create an experiment first.
compare.pickBoth: Pick two runs to compare them.
compare.runNotFound: One of the selected runs does not exist.
compare.invalidSelection: The selection is not valid. Pick two runs from the lists.
compare.warnModeMismatch: The runs have different modes ({a} vs {b}). Calls forced by a test and calls proposed by an agent are not directly comparable.
compare.warnScenarioMismatch: The runs belong to different scenarios ({a} vs {b}).
compare.warnNotCompleted: At least one run has not completed, so its calls may be incomplete.
compare.policySame: Both runs used the same permissions and mock approvals.
compare.noCalls: Neither run recorded a tool call.
compare.noChanges: No call differs in verdict or outcome.
compare.changedCount: {changed} of {total} calls differ in verdict or outcome.
compare.causeNote: Each side is a single run. A difference can come from the policy differences above or from the model varying between runs. This table does not say which.

demo.title: Demo
demo.intro: A pre-recorded run of "Review ≠ Edit": the user asks only for a review, and one of the agent's calls goes beyond that.
demo.scriptedNote: This sequence was written by hand to show how an overreach attempt appears. It is not captured from a model, so it says nothing about how often real agents do this.
demo.savedRunHint: Open the same sequence as a saved run to see the full trace page or the forensic report. No LLM is called.
demo.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
demo.errorServer: The server could not prepare the demo run. Try again in a moment.
demo.liveHint: To see what a real model does with a normal request, start a live run. This calls an LLM API and needs a server API key.
